reason: B is the better proposal because a defined minor B addition offers a more physically plausible route to suppress grain-boundary cracking while perturbing the composition-sensitive bulk caloric transformation less than an ambiguously substituted 2–3 at.% Zr addition, which could promote brittle intermetallics. Both proposals lack quantitative operating boundaries and falsification thresholds, and B lacks supporting evidence, but its intervention and controlled comparison are clearer and more directly aligned with the integrity limitation.
